name: Positive Teaching Dimension / Maximum Positive Degree
details: For every finite binary class, positive teaching dimension dominates maximum positive degree.
proof: If $g$ is a smaller one-inclusion neighbour of $h$, it differs from $h$ at one coordinate $x$ with $h(x)=1$ and $g(x)=0$. Any positive teaching set for $h$ must include $x$, or else it is also consistent with $g$. These required coordinates are distinct for distinct smaller neighbours, so the minimum positive teaching-set size of $h$ is at least its positive degree. Maximize over $h$.
witness_verification: For every nontrivial addressing class, the established values are $\mathrm{TD}^+=1$ and $\mathrm d^+_{\max}=0$.
